---

## Transfer packet delivered — 2026-02-14

Evidence snapshot: 2026-02-12 18:00 UTC. Delivery cut-off: Season Pass handoff review, 2026-02-14 15:00 UTC (delivered ahead of the hold).

**Register:** https://drive.google.com/file/d/b457f16a4e91218a/view — "Season Pass transfer register.csv" in the engineering transfer folder.

**Class totals (128 components):** READY 50 · WATCH 11 · HOLD 67

### HOLD blockers by failed condition

**5. Missing input — 5**

### Historical event comparison (context only)
Separate population from the engineering components: completed Zombie Match 3D Season Pass events with END_DATE on or before 2026-02-12 — **6 events, 754 participants** (LIVE_OPS.EVENTS.LIVE_EVENT_PERFORMANCE).

### Scope and handling notes
- Population: Season Pass cohort matrix, game = Zombie Match 3D and Transfer = include (SP-001…SP-128). DD-CONCEPT (Domino Delights) and SP-PROPOSAL (Transfer = proposal) excluded.
- Validation for SP-017, SP-054, SP-065 and SP-101 taken from the re-mapped issues ZOM-802, ZOM-803, ZOM-804 and ZOM-805 per the Control tab.
- Validation issues and all component PRs left unchanged. No deployment and no external communication. Evidence review only — not an approval to ship.

input.body:
Arthur,

The Season Pass transfer packet is done and delivered now, ahead of tomorrow's review hold.

Register (you have reader access; no public or domain-wide link):
https://drive.google.com/file/d/b457f16a4e91218a/view
"Season Pass transfer register.csv" in the engineering transfer folder.

Class totals over the 128 included components (game = Zombie Match 3D, Transfer = include):
  READY 50
  WATCH 11
  HOLD  67

Evidence snapshot: 2026-02-12 18:00 UTC. Delivery cut-off: the confirmed "Season Pass handoff review" hold on 2026-02-14 15:00 UTC.

HOLD blockers by failed condition (a component is counted under every condition it fails, so these add up to more than 67):
  failed assertions above zero - 28
  test artifact different from the receipt artifact - 4
  selected transfer review not APPROVED for the receipt artifact - 28
  billing hold active at the snapshot - 12
  missing input - 5

Historical event comparison, kept separate from the component population: 6 completed Zombie Match 3D Season Pass events through 2026-02-12, 754 participants.

A few selection notes, since they moved several rows:
- Receipts were taken by replaying each PR's own-package journal by effective_at through the snapshot. Rollbacks restore the earlier issued receipt; copies never restore a withdrawn one, which leaves SP-031, SP-049, SP-067, SP-103 and SP-121 with no current receipt (missing input).
- Re-exports pasted onto the wrong PR were skipped, as you confirmed in the thread; each component uses the receipt naming its own package.
- Reviews follow the transfer lane only, inside the acceptance epoch of the active receipt. Where a review was dismissed after the snapshot the submitted decision still stands; where it was dismissed before, it does not.
- Validation for SP-017, SP-054, SP-065 and SP-101 came from the re-mapped issues ZOM-802/803/804/805.
- The "Season Pass release console export - Feb 13" sheet reports latest-posted artifact and latest-submitted review, which is the superseded convention, so I did not use it; it disagrees with the register on a number of rows.

ZOM-801 has the register link, totals and the per-condition blocker lists appended, and is now In Validation. Validation issues and all component PRs are untouched, and nothing was deployed or sent outside.

Oliver

input.message:
Season Pass transfer packet is done and sent to you, Arthur — delivered now rather than waiting for the review hold.

**Totals over the 128 included components (Zombie Match 3D, Transfer = include): READY 50 · WATCH 11 · HOLD 67**

Register: https://drive.google.com/file/d/b457f16a4e91218a/view — "Season Pass transfer register.csv" in the engineering transfer folder (you have reader access; no cc, no attachment, no public link).

Evidence snapshot 2026-02-12 18:00 UTC; cut-off is the confirmed "Season Pass handoff review" on 2026-02-14 15:00 UTC.

HOLD blockers by failed condition (components are counted under every condition they fail, so these exceed 67): failed assertions 28 · test artifact ≠ receipt artifact 4 · transfer review not APPROVED for the receipt artifact 28 · billing hold active at snapshot 12 · missing input 5.

Historical comparison, kept separate from the component population: 6 completed Zombie Match 3D Season Pass events through Feb 12, 754 participants.

Review slide updated with the totals, link, snapshot and the separately labelled historical comparison. ZOM-801 has the link, totals and per-condition blocker lists appended and is now In Validation; validation issues and all component PRs untouched.

Robert — on your question, I used each PR's own-package receipt only, so the pasted re-exports (incl. the 010 receipt on #553) are skipped. Five components end up with no current receipt at the snapshot because a withdrawal was followed only by an audit copy: SP-031, SP-049, SP-067, SP-103, SP-121 — those are logged as missing input rather than falling back to the older upload.

One flag: the "Season Pass release console export - Feb 13" sheet reports latest-posted artifact and latest-submitted review, which is the superseded convention, so I didn't use it — it disagrees with the register on a number of rows (e.g. SP-002, where the rollback makes the store receipt active). Evidence review only, not an approval to ship.
